summary: Iteration 44 Batch C+D full test pass (backend + frontend). New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_batch_cd.py (21 tests, 21 passed) covering Vendors CRUD/search/PO-history/RBAC/invalid-ids, Readings estimated_monthly_kwh + generation logs + reading_analysis math, Audit issue owner_name persistence, employee-scores POST/GET + validation + RBAC, operational_expense report isolation + date filter, and regression checks (customer_credit no cost/margin leak, assets list + category filter). Frontend Playwright flows all passed: Vendors nav (admin) -> create/search/edit/PO-history/archive; Readings Log Generation dialog (2 entries, Generation column shows 'kWh actual' / 'Est. .. logs'); Audit issue with Owner rendered as '· Owner: Ravi QA · Due: 2026-07-30'; User Management Log Performance dialog submits and shows in Employee Performance report; all 3 new report cards render summary+chart+table; PDF/Excel export clicked with no JS errors; Assets page renders 1 asset with populated category filter (item 6 claim verified); Customer Credit report columns are financial-only (item 5 claim verified). Staff RBAC verified both API (403) and UI (Vendors/Reports/User Management nav hidden, /dashboard/vendors redirects to /dashboard).

minor.issue: estimated_total_kwh = estimated_monthly_kwh * (len(logs) or 1). A site with an estimate but zero generation logs is reported as actual=0 vs estimated=est_monthly => variance -100% / 'Below Estimate', which is misleading. Suggest a distinct status such as 'No logs yet' or excluding zero-log sites from variance.

Rows include every user document (20 incl. inactive/test accounts), and projects_assigned/completed/revenue are derived from project.created_by (creator) rather than an assignee field although the column is labelled 'Projects Assigned'.

ui_bugs.issue: Generic formatter prefixes a rupee symbol to any numeric summary value > 999 (ReportsPage.js line 246), so Reading Analysis shows 'TOTAL ESTIMATED KWH = Rs 1,350' and 'TOTAL ACTUAL KWH = Rs 1,310' (kWh rendered as currency). 'OVERALL VARIANCE PCT = -3' also lacks a % suffix and drops the decimal.
Archive uses browser window.confirm() instead of the app's shadcn AlertDialog — inconsistent with rest of app UX.
No debounce: fetchAll is keyed on `search`, so a GET /api/vendors fires on every keystroke.

issues: kWh KPIs displayed with rupee symbol

action_items: ReportsPage.js line 246: make the currency prefix report/field aware (skip kWh, count and pct keys) and append % to variance/pct keys.
reading_analysis: give zero-log sites a neutral status instead of -100% 'Below Estimate'.
employee_performance: filter out inactive/test users or rename columns to reflect that metrics are creator-based, not assignee-based.
Optional polish: debounce vendor search input; replace window.confirm archive with AlertDialog.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/vendors.py declares `router = APIRouter()` at module scope but registers routes inside create_router(); a second create_router() call would duplicate route registration. Move APIRouter() inside the factory.
GET /vendors/{id}/purchase-orders links POs by case-insensitive exact vendor.name match — renaming a vendor silently breaks PO history. Consider storing vendor_id on purchase_orders.
backend/server.py is 7368 lines — reports block alone spans ~500 lines; split reports/readings/audits into modules like vendors.py.
